title: New Saga
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The magic knight Kyle (Kail) defeats the demon king but loses every friend, family member and love in the war. Touching a strange gem, he is sent back to his younger self and resolves to become a famous hero early, so the nations will be ready. With his friend Theron, childhood friend Lise, elf sorceress Urza and the spirit queen in his sword, he foils a royal assassination plot and fights demons, learning that not all demons want war.
life_message: Learn from past mistakes, prepare others for hard times and protect the people you love before it is too late.

content.note: War with a demon army; Kyle kills a knight captain and the scheming king (Wikipedia; AniList Swordplay, Demons).
Loss of all loved ones in the first timeline (Wikipedia; MangaUpdates Tragic Past).
Love rivals Lise and Urza; a perverted best friend (Wikipedia); harem tags (MangaUpdates).
Kyle had major depressive disorder before the war; his change is a relief to those close to him (Wikipedia).

dominant: Second-chance heroism; foresight and duty; friendship

frames.aligns: Laying down one's life for friends; just war against invaders.
frames.concerns: Kyle kills a king to stop him; magic contracts.

frames.aligns: Repentance-like chance to undo past failures.
frames.concerns: Killing in war; magic and summoning.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Survival of the human lands at stake.

folkways.japan: A narō-originated 'redo' fantasy built on Western medieval tropes, popular with Japanese web-novel readers.

delivery.evidence: Summaries show values through Kyle's choices; no reviewer comment on preachiness (to verify).
delivery.note: The enemy side includes a ruler who wants peace, adding some nuance to the demon war.

winners_losers: Kyle's foresight saves rulers and friends; schemers and war-seeking demons lose.
